description:
Sound Baths can help quiet the mind to take you on a meditative journey connecting with the elements and awakening the chakra centers. The soothing sounds create vibration that will move through body, mind, and spirit to help relieve tension and stress and encourage optimal functioning. Participants may feel more relaxed and able to focus. Some may experience healing that is ready to be cleared. The body may feel lighter and more energetic.

The session begins with meditation to draw awareness into relaxing the body. Then you are guided to connect with an element that will help you to let go and to keep the mind still. Several different sound instruments will be played including crystal bowls, tibetan bowls, drums, chimes, and gongs. These will help quiet the mind and keep you in a peaceful state. At the end we return to a meditation to open up the chakras and prepare you for your best day.

**About Your Paradise Sound Healing Experience**

Relax and unwind during a peaceful waterfront Sound Healing experience overlooking the beautiful Mission Bay. Surrounded by gentle ocean breezes, warm California sunshine, and breathtaking views, it's the perfect setting to restore your mind, body, and spirit.
